skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The local tax-checking code appears non-networked, but the skill also pushes agents into an external paid purchase and skill-installation workflow that is broader than the advertised free checker.

dimensions.detail: Read and Bash are proportionate for running the bundled local Node.js checker, and the inspected code only reads local input and uses the bundled engine. The commerce flow, however, would require network and installation authority outside the advertised local execution boundary.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package itself has no dependency installer or auto-start behavior, but its instructions route users and agents to external SkillPay pages, an external GitHub Pages page, and a raw HTTP IP purchase endpoint for a follow-on install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions require the agent to present paid options on each use and, if selected, follow external purchase/install instructions, fetch or present payment links/QR codes, and install another skill. The artifact includes user-control language and says not to pay for the user, but the scope is still materially broader than the stated local-only checker.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistent service, memory write, credential access, or destructive operation was found in the bundled code. The optional paid-flow instructions can lead to installation of another skill, so users should treat that as a separate privileged action.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core capability is coherent: a local Node.js checker for Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment tables. The concern is that SKILL.md also mandates a free-versus-paid upsell and gives agent instructions to complete an external purchase and install a paid skill, which expands beyond document checking.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a Chinese-language local checker for enterprise income tax adjustment tables. Treat the bundled free checker as local, but do not let an agent follow the paid purchase or external skill-installation instructions unless you intentionally approve that separate commerce/install flow and verify the merchant, product, amount, and platform rules yourself.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: the code does not make network requests, but SKILL.md and normal output contain external purchase links despite strong local/no-network/no-payment framing.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted: the detailed paid purchase and installation orchestration is related to a fuller product tier, but it is broader than the free tax-checking function and involves commerce plus external installation.
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced scripts/run.mjs file was present and manually inspected, and the run path resolves to bundled local code.
[P9] unexpected: Downgraded: the blank-line padding was real, but manual inspection found the following content was the optional full-version purchase section rather than hidden destructive or exfiltration instructions.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded for security verdict: the skill is Chinese-language and China-tax specific, which fits the stated use case, though clearer locale documentation would help users.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Partially accepted as a quality concern: the engine clearly lists checks_not_run, but the disclaimer also references limit-rate metadata in a way that could overstate what the free version actually checks.
